source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to carbonyl compounds (PDF 101-102).

blocks.text: Structural unit C=O carbonyl group hai. Aldehydes aur ketones aise compounds ki qismein hain jin mein carbonyl group ho: aldehyde, RCHO, mein carbonyl carbon par kam az kam aik hydrogen atom hota hai; ketone, RCOR', mein yeh do carbon groups se jura hota hai. Yeh compounds qudrat mein wafir hain aur har saal bari miqdar mein banaye jate hain. Aldehydes bohat se masalon, phalon aur qudrati khushbuon mein hain; ketones dawa, kimiyai aur paint ki sanaton mein use hote hain. Sab se aam ketone acetone (propanone) hai, jo nail polish utarne wale maadde mein hota hai.

blocks.alt: Aam banawatein: R-C(=O)-H (Aldehydes) aur R-C(=O)-R (Ketones), dono mein O carbonyl carbon ke oopar double bond se.
blocks.caption: Aldehydes aur ketones ki aam banawat (kitab ke PDF safha 102 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Kadwe badam ki boo aur zaiqa benzaldehyde, C6H5CHO, ki wajah se hai. Acetone (propanone), CH3COCH3, nail polish utarne wale maadde mein use hota hai.

blocks.alt: Benzaldehyde: benzene ring par CHO group, C ka O se double bond aur neeche H. Acetone (propanone): C ke oopar O double bond se, neeche H3C aur CH3, label 'Acetone (Propanone)'.
blocks.caption: Dilchasp maloomat ke dabbe se benzaldehyde aur acetone (propanone) (kitab ke PDF safha 102 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Aldehyde aur ketone mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Aldehyde mein carbonyl carbon par kam az kam aik hydrogen hota hai (RCHO); ketone mein yeh do carbon groups se jura hota hai (RCOR').

items: Aldehyde RCHO (C=O par H); ketone RCOR' (do C groups).
